column4: Any person without authority introduces or attempts

column3: to introduce into any Centre for Rehabilitation, or supplies
or  attempts  to  supply  any  person  in  such  Centre  with  a
dangerous drug, narcotic drug or psychotropic substance or
any unauthorised article as may be prescribed, commits an
offence  under  this  Act  and  shall  be  liable  on  conviction
after summary trial by a Magistrate to a fine not exceeding
five hundred thousand rupees or to imprisonment of either
description for a period not exceeding two years or to both
such fine and imprisonment.
